items.text: ✨ Logging in with your phone number is now instant (it used to take a long time).
✨ A vote bubble and the real event it became are shown once on the calendar, not twice.
✨ Home now has a mini calendar of your clubs, and "What's on today" lives in the Calendar tab. Inside the 4DS app, the "add to Home Screen" step is gone.
✨ When you're signed in, Home now starts with your clubs (always shown), plus extras you can switch on or off with the Customize button — and your choices follow you to any device.
✨ Badminton now lives inside 4DS at 4dasistas.ca/badminton, with the same login as the rest of the site. The leaderboard is public (first names and last initials only).
✨ On phones, the main tabs are now a bar at the bottom of the screen, easy to reach with your thumb.
✨ A new “For you” list at the top of Clubs shows what needs you: availability to add, payments due, events that need a date, and your next events.
✨ The club calendar has a “My clubs / All clubs” switch, and you now get a quick confirmation after you RSVP, show interest or submit availability.
✨ Quran, Badminton, Cowork and Steps are now full clubs, with their own events, calendar and availability. The Squads tab is gone — find them under Clubs.

✨ Everyone who was in a squad can log in and choose which of these clubs to stay in or join. There's no limit on how many clubs you can be in, but inactive members who don't communicate in the group will be removed.

✨ Some club events don't have a date yet. They now show under “TO BE SCHEDULED” on your club calendar — tap “Show interest” (after confirming your availability is filled in) and we'll pick a date that works.
✨ When a new availability period is open and you haven't added yours yet, you'll get a friendly prompt when you sign in with a button straight to it.
✨ The club calendar now shows every event since the beginning, including past ones — and for past events it says who attended.
✨ Tap a past event to see who attended (first names only), and tap a name to see when they joined and which clubs they're in. Clubs have a public member list the same way — nothing else is shown.

updates.title: Club calendar on your home page

items.text: ✨ The club calendar now sits right on your Clubs home page, under the clubs you're in.
✨ Vote: the add-an-idea fields are right there — no extra tap — and the ideas from all your clubs are below to vote on.
✨ Availability: pick a period to look back at everyone's availability from earlier periods.

updates.title: Event forms: sign up right in the form

items.text: ✨ Events with a form open straight to the form — fill it in to sign up (that's your RSVP). Already a member? Find yourself by name and enter your PIN right on the form.
✨ New here? The form asks for your name, phone and a 4-digit PIN, and your 4DASISTAS account is created automatically as you sign up.
✨ Anyone who fills a form shows in the event's attendee list with their answers.
✨ Some club events now have a sign-up form — open the event to fill it in and update your answers any time.
✨ Admins can build a form for any club event (“Create a form” when adding or editing an event): add, reorder and edit questions, preview it, and see everyone's answers (with a CSV download).
✨ The main Calendar now has a Clubs button: tap it (then a club) to see that club's events and dated ideas. Tap one to see details and RSVP.
✨ In ⚙️ Settings you can now choose which notifications you get: reminders, announcements, club updates, squad updates and new club events.
✨ Ideas that an admin gives a date now show on the club calendar and the main calendar.
✨ New availability periods can have a fill-in deadline, shown to members; admins get ready-made WhatsApp messages (welcome, new period with deadline) for each person.
✨ New ⚙️ Settings (top-right power button): change your profile picture, last name, username and PIN, see your clubs, and turn notifications on or off.
✨ Admins can see who went to past events and add people who came along.
✨ Club calendar events now show on the main calendar too (name + date) — tap one to log in and RSVP.
✨ When a new availability period opens you'll see a banner on your Clubs page with a button to add yours.
✨ Every availability period is now saved — you can look back at everyone's availability from an older period.
✨ After saving a new period you're asked whether to announce it (banner + push) and can WhatsApp people personally.
✨ New Club calendar: anyone can see event names and dates; log in to see details and RSVP. It's the third button next to Availability and Vote.
✨ People in the club are marked going right away; people from other clubs send a request that an admin accepts.
✨ Admins and club admins can add, edit and remove events and see who's coming (and who's waiting for approval).

✨ All emails (join requests, new events, squad requests, suggestions, new members, backups and the daily digest) now use the 4DASISTAS look — rose header, cream background, brown-outlined cards and pill buttons.
✨ The Accept / Edit / Deny review pages opened from emails got the same look.

✨ Club admins now see the same profile details as the main admin — phone, join date, last sign-in, their sign-up picks (in order) and comments — for people in their clubs and anyone who has asked to join.
✨ Join requests now show who is asking: phone number, their top picks, what they wrote, and whether they'd like to lead.
✨ Club admins can add or remove people from their own clubs (and accept or decline requests), but only the main admin can edit profile details, reset PINs or delete profiles.
✨ After you sign in you'll now see a pop-up like this whenever something new ships — with the update number and what was added or fixed.
✨ Missed one? Open the power button menu (top right) and tap “✨ What's new” any time.
✨ New club: M&M — movies, musicals, museums and other fun exhibitions around the GTA.
✨ The menu tabs (Calendar, Clubs, Squads, Directory) are real links now — right-click one to open it in a new tab.
✨ Fixed: the site could hit a daily Cloudflare limit and go blank. Profiles and availability now run on a faster, limit-free database.
✨ Daily backup email now covers the whole project and arrives once a day.

updates.title: One availability period + new admin page

items.text: ✨ Availability now covers one fixed period (Oct 8–20 for now) — the same days everywhere. Days after it are blocked until the next period opens.
✨ Tap a time in “Everyone's availability” to see who prefers it, who's free, who can't — and who hasn't voted yet.
✨ Submitting your availability now asks “Are you sure?” first: empty times count as free (not preferred), red means you can't.
✨ Club admins: your own login for your clubs — official events, profiles, availability and reminders to your members.
✨ The admin page is organised into three grids (Clubs, Notifications & team, Profiles) with collapsible sections.
✨ Admin: assign squads to any profile, archive past or travelling members, reword the WhatsApp messages, and see “Reminder sent” on reminders.
✨ Admin: pick a club first on the availability calendar, see the best times ranked, and tap a time to see who voted what.
✨ Votes and availability now save on your phone when you're offline and sync automatically when you're back.
✨ Your clubs, Travel, About and Add to Home Screen now float as round bubbles.
✨ Squads: request any squad and get its private invite link once an admin approves you.
✨ Turn on notifications to hear about approvals, reminders and event updates.

earlier.title: Squads, joining clubs and event submissions

items.text: ✨ The Squads tab: small casual crews around one regular thing (Quran, Badminton, Cowork, Steps) — request one and get its private WhatsApp link.
✨ Joining a club now needs an admin's approval, and your first pick is requested automatically when you sign up (you can pick two clubs).
✨ Anyone can submit an event or a resource for the calendar from the new Submit buttons — an admin reviews every one.
✨ Everyone's availability heat-map (best and worst times) and green / red / yellow availability slots.
✨ Admin: one card per member with club tags, an availability calendar with filters, profile pop-ups with phone numbers, and email notifications with one-tap Accept / Edit / Deny links.
✨ Sign up creates your login (firstname.lastinitial) with your own PIN, and you can change your PIN any time.
✨ The signed-in Clubs page shows the clubs you're in, your availability, and idea bubbles to vote on.
✨ Idea boards got prices, per-club titles (“THE CUISINE CLUB”) and members-only voting.

earlier.title: Availability grids on every club board

items.text: ✨ “Add your availability” — a quick grid for the next days — plus an “Everyone's availability” view so clubs can pick times that work.
✨ Search bar fixes, a trips continent filter, and a pickleball / sport dropdown clean-up.
✨ Idea boards: add an activity idea with a Google Maps place, and everyone votes — the more votes, the bigger the bubble grows.
✨ Club members got a month-view availability picker (morning / afternoon / night) and the first Sign Up form that creates a login.
✨ Every tab and sub-tab got its own shareable link (like #/calendar or #/clubs).
✨ Events can now repeat monthly (e.g. every 2nd Saturday) as well as weekly.

earlier.title: Admin editing right on the site

items.text: ✨ Admins can create, edit and delete events and resources straight from the site (no separate CMS), with a Google address search limited to Canada and a “needs details” review queue.
✨ The app remembers which tab you were on when you reopen it from your Home Screen, and works better on iPhone (safe areas, no accidental zoom).
✨ A simpler 4-item menu bar, with Travel and About on the Home page.

earlier.title: Audience labels and the Knowledge calendar

items.text: ✨ Every event shows who it's for: Muslim Women, Hijabi Friendly, Family Event, All Women or Muslim Youth.
✨ “Mosque Programs” became Knowledge (classes, halaqahs, talks), and many events were re-sorted into the right calendar.
✨ A big batch of new trips, retreats and community functions was added.

earlier.title: Week strip and private club schedules

items.text: ✨ The Home page's What's On Today has Day / Week / Month views with a swipeable strip.
✨ Events get an automatic emoji, and Calendar has Day / Week / Month views.
✨ The first private “Club Members Schedule”: usernames and a PIN so each club could share availability.
✨ A new About page with a volunteer sign-up form.

earlier.title: Travel globe, support groups and Instagram events

items.text: ✨ An interactive globe for Trips, plus a trips list with upcoming / past.
✨ A Support Groups page and expanded Mental Health resources.
✨ Dozens of real events and resources from Instagram: community BBQs, festivals, retreats, workshops, small businesses and more.
✨ Filter by several event types at once, events that appear in more than one calendar, end times, all-day events and an “Organized by” line.
✨ 4DASISTAS became an installable app: Add to Home Screen, works offline, with its own icon.
✨ Subscribe to the calendar in Apple / Google Calendar (a live calendar.ics feed).
✨ Event pages show a map, and the new Clubs tab lists the community's clubs.
✨ The first 4DASISTAS: a community calendar for Muslim women in the GTA — sports, activities, community functions and trips — with Upcoming / Past filters.
✨ A Resources directory of 80+ Muslim-owned businesses, mosques, cafes and restaurants, with a map and a list view.
✨ A fresh colour palette and a mobile-friendly layout.
